en.summary: The commit corrects the compile-time SIMT thread-count parameter from 4 to 8, which otherwise under-sizes lane-dependent structures and thread-coordinate geometry in the generated hardware.
why_it_counts: It changes a central hardware elaboration parameter rather than software or tests.
The same file immediately derives depth_thread, num_lane, dcache_BlockWords, and tc_dim from num_thread.
Using the wrong thread count changes the generated DUT structure and execution width, not just a build option label.
disqualifiers: This is a parameter-level correction rather than a localized datapath edit.
evidence: ventus/src/pipeline/parameters.scala changes def num_thread from 4 to 8.
depth_thread, num_lane, dcache_BlockWords, and tc_dim are derived from num_thread in the same object.
The tc_dim logic has an explicit special case for num_thread == 8, which shows that 8-thread geometry is architecturally intended in this design snapshot.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a SIMT GPU, a compile-time thread-per-warp constant drives lane count, per-thread vector widths, cacheline geometry, and thread-coordinate mapping. If that constant is set too low, the generated RTL only provisions part of the architected wavefront and downstream structures inherit the wrong geometry.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Any workload or microarchitectural path assumes the intended full thread count, but elaboration used a smaller constant for warp or lane width.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Set the hardware thread-count constant below the intended architectural value while leaving all derived constants tied to that faulty parameter.
portability_notes: Apply this to any compile-time parameter that defines lanes per wavefront, threads per warp, or SIMD width for the RTL.
Inspect downstream constants derived from the same parameter, such as lane count, block words, address slicing, or thread-coordinate decode.
This is most useful in parameterized generators where one wrong constant fans out into many widths and resource counts.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the elaboration-time constant that defines the number of hardware threads or lanes per warp.
Reduce that constant below the intended value without changing higher-level architectural assumptions or tests.
Regenerate the DUT so all derived widths and geometry expressions inherit the smaller value.
Run a workload that expects the full thread width and observe half-width or otherwise malformed execution behavior.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes num_thread from 4 to 8. The same parameter object derives depth_thread, num_lane, dcache_BlockWords, and tc_dim from that value.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Change def num_thread back from 8 to 4 in ventus/src/pipeline/parameters.scala and let the existing derived constants continue to follow the faulty value.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The generated GPU executes with too few active threads or lanes per warp and propagates the wrong geometry into cache-block sizing and thread-coordinate mapping.
evidence_for_injection: num_thread is the only changed line in the commit.
Multiple downstream structural parameters are derived from num_thread in the same file.
The tc_dim branch explicitly recognizes 8-thread geometry, which supports the interpretation that 4 was an erroneous hardware parameter.
notes: This is a broad parameter-level fault, so it can affect multiple modules after elaboration rather than one local RTL block.

zh.summary: 该提交把编译期的 SIMT 线程数参数从 4 改为 8；如果保持 4，不仅会缩小硬件线程宽度，还会让生成后的 lane 相关结构和线程坐标几何都偏小。
why_it_counts: 它修改的是核心硬件展开参数，而不是软件或测试。
同一文件里，depth_thread、num_lane、dcache_BlockWords 和 tc_dim 都直接从 num_thread 推导。
错误的线程数会改变生成后的 DUT 结构和执行宽度，而不只是一个构建选项标签。
disqualifiers: 这是一处参数级修正，而不是局部数据通路逻辑修改。
evidence: ventus/src/pipeline/parameters.scala 把 def num_thread 从 4 改为 8。
在同一个参数对象中，depth_thread、num_lane、dcache_BlockWords 和 tc_dim 都由 num_thread 推导。
tc_dim 逻辑对 num_thread == 8 有显式特判，说明在这个设计快照中 8 线程几何是架构预期。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在 SIMT GPU 中，编译期的“每个 warp 的线程数”常量会驱动车道数、逐线程向量宽度、cacheline 几何以及线程坐标映射。如果这个常量被设得过小，生成出来的 RTL 只会为部分架构 wavefront 配置资源，下游结构也会继承错误的几何关系。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: SIMT 车道数和线程数参数化
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 工作负载或微架构路径按预期的完整线程数运行，但 RTL 展开时却用了更小的 warp 或 lane 宽度常量。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把硬件线程数常量设置得低于架构预期，同时让所有派生常量继续跟随这个错误值。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何定义“每个 wavefront 的 lane 数”“每个 warp 的线程数”或 RTL SIMD 宽度的编译期参数。
需要同时检查从这个参数派生出来的 lane 数、block words、地址切片或线程坐标解码等量。
这种故障特别适合参数化生成器，因为一个错误常量会扩散到很多位宽和资源数量。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到定义每个 warp 的硬件线程数或 lane 数的展开期常量。
在不改变更高层架构假设或测试的情况下，把该常量调小。
重新生成 DUT，让所有派生位宽和几何表达式都继承这个更小的值。
运行一个依赖完整线程宽度的工作负载，并观察半宽或其它异常的执行行为。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: pipeline.parameters.num_thread 及其派生的 lane/cache 几何
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 num_thread 从 4 改为 8。同一个参数对象还会基于该值推导 depth_thread、num_lane、dcache_BlockWords 和 tc_dim。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 ventus/src/pipeline/parameters.scala 中把 def num_thread 从 8 改回 4，并让已有的派生常量继续跟随这个错误值。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 生成后的 GPU 会以过少的每 warp 活动线程或车道运行，并把错误几何继续传播到 cache block 尺寸和线程坐标映射中。
evidence_for_injection: 这个提交只改了一行 num_thread。
同一文件中有多个下游结构参数都由 num_thread 推导。
tc_dim 的分支对 8 线程几何有显式处理，这支持“4 是错误硬件参数”的判断。
notes: 这是一个较宽泛的参数级故障，因此展开后可能同时影响多个模块，而不是某一个局部 RTL 代码块。
